result.reason: The operative language establishes a mutual aggregate cap at the greater of 12 months’ fees paid or payable and US$1,000,000, includes all required uncapped carve-outs, and excludes Corio’s payment obligations from the cap and from damages. It also retains a mutual exclusion of indirect and consequential damages. However, the fee lookback runs from the event giving rise to the claim rather than from the claim, as specified by the preferred position; this is an unnecessary timing change that may alter the applicable fee base. Drafting is otherwise professional, though “total aggregate” is redundant and the definition of Excluded Claims could more precisely refer to liability arising from the listed matters.
